summary: The stream authoring CLI tests wait up to 10 seconds for a stream session to start or retire, instead of three 50 ms polls or 100 20 ms polls, so a slow first start on a loaded host no longer fails them.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to restore the fixed poll counts.
